name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
summary: In the Cauldron, a bounty calls for Overseer Maltorius's death. It names him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and the newly hired commander of the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew. Overseer Oilfist orders his head brought to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker as proof.

sections.title: A Price on a Traitor
sections.body: In the Cauldron's Slag Pit, you are sent to find and slay Overseer Maltorius. The notice calls him a traitorous Dark Iron dwarf. Bring his head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker to claim the bounty.

faq.answer: Overseer Maltorius is a traitorous Dark Iron dwarf. The notice calls him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and the newly hired commander of the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew in the Cauldron.

faq.q: Where can Overseer Maltorius be found?
faq.answer: Overseer Maltorius can be found in the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron.

faq.q: Who ordered the death of Overseer Maltorius?
faq.answer: Overseer Oilfist ordered Overseer Maltorius's death.

faq.q: Who receives proof of Maltorius's death?
aliases: who to turn in maltorius head
faq.answer: Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in Searing Gorge receives proof of Maltorius's death: his head.
